role.title: Power Automate Specialist
role.description: Create and optimize workflows using Power Automate. Experience with connectors and API integrations required.

summary: Avery is a senior Power Platform engineer with 8+ years delivering automation and integration solutions. Strong on Power Automate, connectors, and API integration, with measurable process-optimization outcomes and PL-200/PL-400 certifications.

criteria.name: Workflow Automation
criteria.evidence: Built an HR intake automation pipeline and migrated legacy workflows to Power Automate.

criteria.name: PI and Connector Usage
criteria.evidence: Integrated REST/Graph APIs, Webhooks, Azure Functions and Service Bus via custom connectors.

criteria.name: Error Handling
criteria.evidence: Implemented an error-handling and reliability reporting framework.

criteria.name: Process Optimization
criteria.evidence: Reduced approval cycle time to under 24 hours across multiple employers.

criteria.name: Documentation
criteria.evidence: ALM, CI/CD and solution-aware flows imply strong documentation discipline.

questions.question: Walk me through the most complex Power Automate solution you built end to end. What made it complex and how did you structure it?
How do you decide between a cloud flow, a child flow, and a Dataverse plug-in for a given automation?
Describe how you migrated legacy workflows to Power Automate without disrupting users.
Tell me about a time you built or used a custom connector against a REST or Graph API. What were the auth and pagination challenges?
How have you used Azure Functions or Service Bus alongside Power Automate, and why?
Describe your approach to error handling, retries, and alerting in a production flow.
How do you make a flow idempotent so retries don't double-process records?
Give a concrete example where you measurably reduced a process cycle time. How did you measure it?
How do you document solution-aware flows and hand them over for ALM?
What belongs in run-book documentation for an automation you'd hand to a support team?
